PublicVaultProfile.title: PublicVaultProfile
PublicVaultProfile.description: Publicly visible Vault profile in the Global Overseer Leaderboard and Wasteland Directory.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Vault Overseer.

overseerName.description: Display name or callsign of the Overseer (1-40 chars).

vaultName.description: Custom or designated name of the Vault (1-50 chars).

dayCounter.description: Days survived in the current Vault run (>= 1).

uniqueDwellersCount.description: Count of rare Unique Vault Dwellers recruited (>= 0).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Vault was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Vault profile was last synced.

PublicSupplyDrop.title: PublicSupplyDrop
PublicSupplyDrop.description: Public supply crate broadcast by an Overseer that another player can claim.

senderUid.description: Authenticated UID of the Overseer who broadcast the supply drop.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender Overseer (1-40 chars).

resourceType.description: Type of survival resource inside the supply drop.

message.description: Radio broadcast note attached to the supply drop (1-120 chars).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the supply drop.

claimedByUid.description: Optional UID of the player who claimed the supply drop.

claimedByName.description: Optional display name of the player who claimed the supply drop.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the supply drop was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the supply drop was last updated.

/public_vaults/{userId}.description: Global directory of public player Vaults and Overseer standings.

/public_supply_drops/{dropId}.description: Shared public wasteland supply drops broadcast and claimed by players.
